requirements: R1: The task status synchronization must not mark a task as 'done' if its corresponding GitHub PR is closed but unmerged.

slices.title: Fix task status sync for unmerged PRs
slices.jtbd: When implementing the status check for this epic, I want to verify if a closed PR was actually merged, so that the internal task status accurately reflects reality.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a closed but unmerged PR in the GitHub API mock
When the scheduled sync job runs
Then the internal task status is not marked as done
And the unit test verifies the status update logic is bypassed
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive 'done' task statuses to 0
